Paragraph: "Despair paralyzes effort, O brother; those who succumb to sorrow lose their capacity for action and ultimate victory..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Addressing the debilitating nature of grief on constructive action.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana articulates a crucial psychological insight on how despair paralyzes human agency.
Outcome/Resolution: He delivers a foundational teaching on overcoming cognitive paralysis.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Vishada-Nirodha (Curbing debilitating despair to preserve executive agency)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Teaches that sorrow (Vishada) obscures divine purpose and must be conquered through steady action (Karma).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Behavioral activation theory: unchecked sorrow causes cognitive paralysis, whereas active engagement restores agency.
